concept: Review and integration: what helping others feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of helping without expecting anything, small daily acts, and volunteering for unglamorous tasks — which feels most natural to you?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'service' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
